data.headline: About Smart Sites
data.subheadline: We believe every business deserves a website they can manage themselves.

data.headline: Our Mission
data.body:
Smart Sites Admin was born from a simple idea: web agencies shouldn't be bottlenecked by content updates.

We've built a system that gives clients the freedom to edit their own content, while developers maintain full control over design and functionality.

The result? Happier clients, more efficient agencies, and better websites for everyone.
